_comment: Config for the constraint-13 correction experiment (our key contribution).
description: Compare paper C13 vs corrected C13 on a targeted instance set

variants.label: paper_c13
variants.description: Original Khaled et al. constraint (13): t_sum <= Tmax + M*(2 - y[j,d] - y[j,d'])

variants.label: corrected_c13
variants.description: Corrected formulation: two split constraints, one per endpoint indicator

variants.label: corrected_c13_with_initial
variants.description: Corrected C13 plus pre-horizon accumulated hours (C13b, our extension)

expected_outcome: The paper C13 may produce solutions that violate the cumulative flight-hour constraint (infeasible when checked post-hoc). The corrected C13 should tighten the bound and produce stricter, correct maintenance schedules.
